arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of the Eldritch at the Tree of Whispers.

{c_label}Lucky Hit: {/c}You have up to a {c_random}{SF_0}%{/c} chance to apply {c_important}Hex of Flames{/c}. {c_important}Hex of Flames{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_2]{/c} additional Fire damage each time you deal damage to the target.{if:SF_10} Critical Strikes cause the target to explode dealing the same damage to all nearby enemies.{/if}
{c_important}Hex of Flames{/c} explodes dealing damage to all nearby enemies when you land a Critical Strike.
